summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package's npm preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a bundled file math_init.js on every install. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle (shuffled string/number array with a rotator function and decoder consistent with javascript-obfuscator output; setup.mjs itself uses _0x-hex identifiers) whose behavior cannot be inspected without executing the decoded bytes. The package's stated purpose is a React/legacy-CSS repository configuration; it has no functional need for a separate JavaScript runtime, and the payload is unrelated to that purpose. Because the payload is run under a freshly downloaded, non-Node runtime, Node-based install-time scanners and lifecycle-hook tooling do not observe its behavior. Execution is triggered automatically by `npm install`, before any user code or review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
